questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: What is the direction of magnetic force on a current-carrying conductor?
questions.explanation: F = IL × B. Force is perpendicular to both current and magnetic field.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the empirical formula of glucose?
questions.explanation: Empirical formula of glucose C₆H₁₂O₆ is CH₂O (simplest ratio).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which compound shows isomerism?
questions.explanation: Butane (C₄H₁₀) has structural isomers: n-butane and isobutane.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the order of hydracid strength?
questions.explanation: Hydracid strength increases down the group: HI > HBr > HCl > HF.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of these has maximum oxidation state?
questions.explanation: In MnO₄⁻, Mn has +7 oxidation state, the highest among options.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the functional group in ketones?
questions.explanation: Ketones have C=O (carbonyl) group bonded to two alkyl groups.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If tan θ = 3/4, what is sin θ?
questions.explanation: If tan θ = 3/4, then in right triangle with opposite=3, adjacent=4, hypotenuse=5. sin θ = 3/5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the domain of f(x) = 1/(x-2)?
questions.explanation: f(x) is undefined when denominator = 0, i.e., when x = 2.
